$description: MT resolver manifest. Declares the two theming dimensions (brand, theme) and the order in which DTCG token sets are composed into each brand×theme permutation. Tool-agnostic: this manifest is our own composition spec and lives alongside — not inside — the token values. Set patterns are globs resolved relative to ../src, with {brand} and {theme} substituted per permutation.
name: MT Design System

invariants.$description: System-level invariants enforced by validate.ts. Brand identity may vary accent/neutral/typographic/shape/scale/elevation foundations. Feedback/status semantics are brand-INVARIANT: brands must not redefine them, and they must resolve to the primitive status ramps. Overriding these requires a deliberate, accessibility-reviewed change here — not an incidental brand addition.
